newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices ease, low overseas demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices ease, low overseas demand.

text.p: Indian castorseed December delivery prices fell to 1,148 rupees from 1,154 rupees per quintal on fresh speculative selling, dealers said.
"Fresh demand from exporters was low. Castor export deals were around $730 per tonne last week but buyers now want it for $720 while Indian offers are higher at$ 740," one dealer said.
Groundnut oil fell to 420 rupees per 10 kg from 424 rupees amid sluggish demand and more supplies of imported palm oil.
Rajkot spot oil was steady at 680/685 rupees per 15 kg.
"Bombay is receiving higher arrivals from south India while inflows from Gujarat remained low," the dealer said.
